svg.title: Genome Assembly Pipeline
svg.desc: gcl_genome_assembly (Nextflow DSL2): organelle assembly (HiFi + short-read variants) on top, HiFi+Hi-C and Illumina short-read nuclear inputs, per-sample assembly spine with iterative optional Hi-C scaffolding, QC fan funnelling to a terminal summary report, and a cross-sample Minigraph-Cactus pangenome stage.
svg.text: PacBio HiFi + Hi-C (primary) · Illumina short-read (alternate) · haplotype-resolved, chromosome-scale · multi-sample pangenome · gcl_genome_assembly · Nextflow DSL2
no Hi-C: skip scaffolding (HiFi-only → teloclip; short-read → finalize)
SHORT-READ (ILLUMINA) — alternate assembler for samples without HiFi/Hi-C; contigs join the shared correction → scaffolding → finalization path
Two input modalities: HiFi+Hi-C drive hifiasm; Illumina short-read drives SPAdes (alternate lane).
Organelle assembly, per modality: HiFi → MitoHiFi; short-read → GetOrganelle + MITOS2 → baits Filter organelle.
Dashed borders = conditional steps (find-ref, purging, correction, decontamination, teloclip).
Hi-C scaffolding (YaHS): up to 2 rounds; round 2 only if scaffold correction/decontam ran (else 1).
No Hi-C → scaffolding skipped (HiFi-only → teloclip; short-read → finalize).
All assemblies fan into one Minigraph-Cactus pangenome; Pangenome report links to the Summary report.
